channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: Bonner switches focus to Fermanagh job after Erne Gaels exit
item.description: Declan Bonner was already turning his thoughts towards managing Fermanagh after his tenure as Erne Gaels boss ended with an Ulster club SFC semi-final defeat to Kilcoo last Saturday.

item.title: Ballyshannon and Letterkenny to host Donegal's 'home' League games
item.description: With MacCumhaill Park in Ballybofey unavailable due to pitch improvement works, Ballyshannon's Fr Tierney Park and O'Donnell Park in Letterkenny will host Donegal's three 'home' matches in next year's Allianz Football League.

item.title: McMahon takes over Omagh St Enda's
item.description: Former All Star, All-Ireland winner and double O'Neill cup winner in Tyrone Justin McMahon has been appointed the new senior manager of home town club Omagh St Enda's.

item.title: 'Dirty belt' on Mullen still rankles with Shefflin
item.description: Henry Shefflin is still annoyed over the 'dirty belt' which looks set to rule Adrian Mullen out of the remainder of Ballyhale Shamrocks' club campaign.

item.title: Dempsey departs St Joseph's
item.description: Mick Dempsey has called time on six years as manager of Laois side St Joseph's.

item.title: O'Hagan to double-job following Lavey appointment
item.description: Barry O'Hagan will double up as Armagh U20 and Lavey senior football joint-manager in 2026.

item.title: Horgan takes up Cork U20 selector role
item.description: Patrick Horgan has made a quick return to the Cork hurling scene as an U20 selector.

item.title: 2026 provincial football championship draws take place
item.description: The 2026 provincial senior football championship draws will take place tomorrow evening (Thursday, November 27).

item.title: Thurles to host Munster club SFC decider as final venues revealed
item.description: The fixture details for the 2025 Munster club football championship finals have been confirmed.

item.title: Scotstown star eligible for re-fixture
item.description: Ryan O'Toole will be available for Scotstown's Ulster club SFC semi-final re-fixture against Newbridge on Sunday.
